pr_title: statistics: do not analyze non exist table anymore
pr_body:

### What problem does this PR solve?
<!--

Please create an issue first to describe the problem.

There MUST be one line starting with "Issue Number:  " and
linking the relevant issues via the "close" or "ref".

For more info, check https://pingcap.github.io/tidb-dev-guide/contribute-to-tidb/contribute-code.html#referring-to-an-issue.

-->

Issue Number: close https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/57227

Problem Summary:

### What changed and how does it work?

After https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/pull/57222, we can handle most cases where tables have been dropped. However, there is still a chance that we might attempt to analyze a non-existent table or use incorrect information to perform the analysis.

In this PR, I check the schema and table information before performing the actual analysis. This helps minimize unnecessary analysis work.

issue_context.title: The priority queue cannot correctly handle the drop database event
issue_context.body:
## Bug Report

Please answer these questions before submitting your issue. Thanks!

### 1. Minimal reproduce step (Required)

1. Create a database 
2. Create some tables and insert some data
3. Drop the database

<!-- a step by step guide for reproducing the bug. -->

### 2. What did you expect to see? (Required)

The priority queue can correctly handle the drop database event and clean up any stale jobs associated with it.

### 3. What did you see instead (Required)

It will attempt to analyze non-existent tables.

### 4. What is your TiDB version? (Required)

master

<!-- Paste the output of SELECT tidb_version() -->
